title: SCROBOT real floor-loaded individual wheel PID validation, +90 to 0 RPM
original_test_type: Separate left wheel and right wheel step tests, not simultaneous dual-wheel motion
reference_time_origin: Each source's first sample whose reference_rpm rises from 0 to 90
reference_stop_origin: Each source's first sample whose reference_rpm falls from 90 to 0
interpretation: The merged step/stop reference columns are independently aligned responses from different physical runs. They are not synchronized and cannot establish straight-line or spin-in-place chassis dynamics.
measurement: encoder RPM while floor loaded, with STM32 PID active
resampling: Linear interpolation to a common 0.01 s grid, preserving exact irregular host timestamps in normalized per-wheel data and source recordings
physics_identification_caveat: RPM-only measurements cannot independently identify tire-ground traction, chassis slip, damping, friction, or pose trajectory.
